<a id="architecture"></a>

## Architecture

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| principles | The code and --help are the authority; docs/how is second; the skill is the thing being corrected. Work file by file with the survey row open, re-verify each finding before acting (the survey can be wrong: REJECTED is a valid disposition with proof), and record the disposition in assets/findings.md as you go. Cite, don't restate: where docs/how or a convention (C1-C12) already holds the rule, link it. A finding that exposes a code bug becomes a pij-fleet issue, not a code change. The two gates read the authorities directly (RS_ROUTE_TABLE; the built pij-rs --help) and never copy a verb list (consume the producer, not a duplicate). |
| composition_root | skills/pij/SKILL.md (registry, verb coverage, invariants) with references/00-routing.md conventions; the route and prime files cite them |
| contracts | assets/findings.md: one row per survey row: report, line, verdict, disposition (FIXED\|RULED\|REJECTED\|DEFERRED), evidence, SKILL.md coverage: shim verbs in the existing table (parsed by the TS test); native-only pij-rs subcommands in a separate table the TS forward check does not parse, crates/cli/tests/skill_verb_coverage.rs: parse `pij-rs --help` subcommands, assert each appears in SKILL.md |
| seams | .omp/extensions/pij/core/generation-skill-coverage.test.ts (skillVerbs parser stops at the next '## ' heading), .omp/extensions/pij/core/generation-routing.ts RS_ROUTE_TABLE, crates/cli/src/main.rs clap subcommands (binary pij-rs) |

| decision | solo-pm |

<a id="risks"></a>

## Risks

| id | text | check |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rk-0001 | The coder trusts the survey and 'fixes' a claim that was right. | Each FIXED row cites the --help or code it was checked against; REJECTED is allowed; the reviewer re-checks a sample. |
| rk-0002 | The fix grows the skill (missing features added verbatim). | AC11 line ceiling; cite docs/how instead of restating. |
| rk-0003 | The Rust test builds the binary under load. | C12: nice -n 19, -j 1, timeout -k, load gate. |
| rk-0004 | The coverage tests become a second verb list. | They read RS_ROUTE_TABLE and the built binary's --help; no hard-coded list (a reviewer grep). |
